title: Dynamics 365 Sales: personalise outreach emails written by the Sales Qualification Agent
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documentation supports the optional guidance, consumption licensing and all three control paths. Minor corrections should narrow the targets statement to length and formatting, cite the FAQ for email-generation billing, and remove checklist controls that have no table row.

claims.claim: Personalization guidance is admin-opt-in: settings are optional and the agent keeps its default instructions if none are configured.

claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/sales/sales-qualification-agent-faq to sources and cite its 'What activities consume Copilot Studio capacity?' section for the statement that generating initial outreach emails consumes capacity.

claims.claim: In Sales Hub, guidance is reached through Change area > App Settings > General settings > Dynamics 365 AI hub > Agent manager > Create and manage agent > Email instructions > AI Personalization > Email guidance.
claims.quote: Open the Sales Qualification Agent settings. In the Email instructions section, select the AI Personalization option. In the Email guidance field, select the pencil icon to open the text editor.
